name: theme
title: Co-Ventures theme
description: Brand, semantic and Tailwind-theme tokens plus base styles. Drops app/coventures.css into the project; @import it from globals.css after tailwindcss.
docs: Add `@import "./coventures.css";` to app/globals.css after `@import "tailwindcss";`, then delete any :root / @theme colour blocks it replaces. Load Ovo and Work Sans via next/font with variable names --font-ovo and --font-work-sans (see README).
